About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact
Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.
We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.
Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.
If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.
Summary
We are seeking a motivated and curious Data Engineer Intern to join our engineering team and gain hands-on experience building and maintaining data infrastructure. In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support the development of data pipelines, data processing systems, and analytics tools that power business intelligence, product development, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.
The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in programming and data concepts, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is eager to learn about modern data engineering technologies and best practices.
This internship offers an opportunity to work on meaningful projects, gain exposure to real-world data systems, and develop technical skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
What You'll Be Doing
Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure that support analytics, business intelligence, and machine learning applications
Support the development of ETL/ELT processes to collect, transform, and organize data from various sources
Write and optimize SQL queries and Python scripts to support data processing, reporting, and analysis
Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and analytics teams to improve data accessibility, quality, and reliability
Help build and maintain data tools and dashboards that provide actionable insights into business and product performance
Gain hands-on experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, data warehouses, and modern data processing technologies
Assist in troubleshooting data pipeline issues, identifying performance improvements, and implementing solutions with guidance from senior engineers
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team meetings while learning engineering best practices
Document data processes, workflows, and technical solutions to support ongoing development and knowledge sharing
We'll be excited if you have
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
Foundational knowledge of Python and SQL, including experience writing queries, manipulating data, or developing scripts through coursework, projects, or internships
Basic understanding of databases, data structures, and data processing concepts
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, or data warehousing concepts
Interest in learning modern AI and data technologies such as Claude, Snowflake, BigQuery, Apache Spark, Flink, or Apache Airflow
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn
Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
A proactive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and enthusiasm for working with data and emerging technologies
Previous technical projects, relevant coursework, or internship experience in data engineering, software development, or analytics is a plus, but not required
Location
The role is on-site and we are looking for candidates in the Bay Area who can go to the San Mateo office.
Compensation
The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated pay range for this role is $20-$25 per hour.
The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.
Don’t hold back
We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Summary
We are seeking an experienced GRC & Privacy Consultant to lead and manage our ongoing SOC 2, GDPR, and broader Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) initiatives. This individual will be responsible for maintaining compliance programs, coordinating security and privacy assessments, managing regulatory requirements, and serving as a key point of contact for customer-facing security and compliance inquiries.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on compliance professional who can independently manage day-to-day compliance activities, partner with internal technical and business teams, and support customer and contractual compliance requirements.
What You’ll Be Doing
SOC 2 & Security Compliance
Manage ongoing SOC 2 compliance activities, including audit readiness, evidence collection, and coordination with external auditors
Conduct periodic access control reviews and vendor risk assessments
Review, maintain, and update security and compliance policies
Oversee data deletion processes to ensure alignment with applicable policies and regulatory requirements
Coordinate incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity tabletop exercises
Oversee penetration testing activities, including coordination with external providers, tracking findings, and remediation follow-up
GDPR, EU AI Act & Privacy Management
Manage GDPR compliance activities and support organizational readiness for applicable EU AI Act requirements
Conduct privacy and compliance reviews of product designs, features, and processes
Coordinate and respond to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and other privacy-related requests
Review and document data flows, processing activities, and data handling practices
Maintain Records of Processing Activities (RoPA) and related privacy documentation
Partner with internal stakeholders to identify and address privacy, data protection, and AI governance risks
Customer-Facing GRC & Contract Support
Serve as the primary point of contact for customer security, privacy, and compliance inquiries
Complete customer security questionnaires and respond to due diligence requests
Participate in customer calls to address SOC 2, GDPR, data protection, and security-related questions
Review customer contracts, Data Processing Agreements (DPAs), and security-related terms
Provide contract redlines and recommendations related to privacy, security, and compliance obligations, coordinating with legal counsel as needed
Security Monitoring & Risk Management
Review security alerts, vulnerability findings, and relevant system logs using tools such as Intruder.io, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, and application logging systems
Coordinate with engineering and infrastructure teams to investigate findings and track remediation
Identify compliance gaps, assess risks, and recommend process improvements
Maintain compliance documentation, risk registers, and supporting evidence
We'll be excited if you have
Demonstrated experience managing SOC 2 compliance programs and supporting external audits
Strong working knowledge of GDPR, data privacy requirements, and GRC best practices
Familiarity with the EU AI Act and emerging AI governance requirements
Experience conducting vendor risk assessments, access reviews, and security policy reviews
Experience responding to customer security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and compliance inquiries
Ability to review security and privacy provisions in commercial agreements and DPAs
Familiarity with cloud security environments, particularly GCP and AWS
Understanding of security monitoring, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and incident response processes
Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally with Engineering, Legal, Sales, and leadership
Ability to independently manage multiple compliance workstreams in a consulting capacity
Anticipated Hours
Approximately 10-15 hours per week, potentially increasing to 20-30 hours per week during compliance audits and certification periods
Locations
The role may be hybrid in one of our offices or remote. For remote, we are looking for candidates based in the United States

Summary
Lights on. Camera live. That’s you! From our Hollywood studio, you’ll host professionally produced live commerce shows for some of the world’s top brands - presenting products in a way that feels like a real conversation, not a rehearsal pitch. You’ll come in prepared: product briefings, rehearsals, and run-throughs are part of the deal so that when the camera goes live, you’re fully in your element. Show after show, you bring energy, polish, and the kind of screen presence that helps audiences discover, engage, and shop in real time.
What You’ll Be Doing
Host engaging, live product shows from Firework’s Hollywood studio
Present products in a way that feels natural, conversational, and authentic
Bring brand messaging to life while keeping delivery unscripted and relatable
Participate in training, product briefings, rehearsals, and show run-throughs
Adapt your tone and style to match different brands and audiences
Maintain strong on-camera presence and professionalism during live broadcasts
We’ll be excited if you have
Confident, engaging on-camera presence
Ability to explain products like you’re talking to a friend - not reading a script
Reliable, punctual, and open to feedback and coaching
Experience in hosting, livestreaming, UGC, acting, or product demos is a plus - but not required
Availability during weekday business hours
Schedule
On-site only at our Hollywood studio (all training, rehearsals, and shows)
Typically 5-10 hours per week, including prep and showtime. May increase for clients with multiple shows per month or complex products.
Primarily weekday schedules, with occasional planned weekend sessions
Shows typically run 8:00am-8:00pm PT, depending on client needs
Compensation
$25-$40 per hour depending on experience and client scope
1099 contractor to start
